mainEntity.name: What features are typically included in a master suite addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A primary bedroom addition typically features a spacious bedroom area, a private en-suite bathroom, and dedicated closet space such as a walk-in. Depending on your goals and square footage, owners often incorporate walk-in showers, double vanities, sitting areas, or direct patio access. When planning the layout, consider how plumbing lines connect to existing wet walls, as placing the en-suite bathroom adjacent to current sewer or supply lines helps streamline construction complexity and cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: A master suite addition generally includes a large bedroom, a dedicated walk-in closet, and an attached private bathroom with fixtures like a walk-in shower or double vanity.
